notes.title: Procedural Generation + Steam Multiplayer
notes.content:
[list]
[*] [h3]Procedural Generation[/h3] 
When you create a new world you will have the option between creating the old flat world or you will be able to create a world with procedurally generated mountains, rivers and terrain.
[*] [h3]Steam Multiplayer[/h3]
The multiplayer now uses steam to host the game, which makes things much simpler. Now you can host a game and invite your friends, no port forwarding required.
[*] [h3]Smooth Lighting[/h3]
[*] [h3]Running Water[/h3]
[*] [h3]New blocks[/h3]
[/list]

notes.title: Bug Fix
notes.content: Fixed bug stopping players from building in empty chunk.

notes.title: Multiplayer Update
notes.content: This patch has added multiplayer and new blocks. In order to play with your friends one person will have to host the server on their computer. Then, their friends will be able to join either through steam or with the IP address of the host. When you are hosting the server remember to port forward in order for people from outside your network to be able to join.
